title: Agent manifest
description: JSON Schema for .agents/agents/<name>/manifest.yaml — declares required, optional, and forbidden skills for an agent.

agent.description: Agent identifier (kebab-case, must match the directory name under .agents/agents/)

required.description: Skills loaded automatically for this agent.

optional.description: Skills available to the agent but not auto-loaded.

forbidden.description: Skills this agent must never use (role isolation).

notes.description: Free-form rationale or notes for maintainers.
